title: Product definition and acceptance

any: product intent is missing or changing
a new user-visible capability or journey is introduced

skill_calls.when: product or journey intent is missing
validated intent needs durable requirements or scenarios
behavior examples need an executable acceptance route

nodes.obligation: Define user outcome, criteria, non-goals, and failure trajectories.
Map behavior examples to observable evidence seams.

tests.evidence: every criterion has an observable PASS/FAIL route

workline_policy: Keep inside planning unless durable product ownership or independent approval requires its own workline.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE only when current authoritative criteria and behavior examples already cover the change.
repair: Missing observable evidence reopens define-acceptance without invalidating unrelated accepted definitions.
